import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def solve(prices, split_factors):
    # Adjust prices for splits
    adjusted_prices = prices * split_factors.cumprod()
    
    # Initialize weights DataFrame with zeros
    weights = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=adjusted_prices.index, columns=adjusted_prices.columns)
    
    # Calculate simple returns
    returns = adjusted_prices.pct_change().dropna()
    
    # Apply diagonal risk parity for each session t >= 61
    for t in range(60, len(returns)):
        # Get the last 60 returns up to t-1
        recent_returns = returns.iloc[t-60:t]
        
        # Calculate inverse sample standard deviations
        inv_std_devs = 1 / recent_returns.std(ddof=1)
        
        # Normalize inverse standard deviations to sum to 1
        normalized_weights = inv_std_devs / inv_std_devs.sum()
        
        # Assign weights to the current day
        weights.iloc[t] = normalized_weights
    
    return weights
